subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

she had __garnered__ the information from various books.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"garnered"** means to collect or gather something, especially information or resources. (संग्रहित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She garnered enough evidence to support her claims in court.
 
 
• **"Dispersed"** refers to the act of distributing or spreading something widely, or scattering it away. It is the opposite of "garnered." (फैलाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The strong wind dispersed the seeds across the field.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"garnered"** is **"dispersed."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Criticised** (आलोचना करना): To express disapproval or find faults in something.
 
 
• **Example: **The movie was heavily criticised for its weak storyline.
 
 
 
• **Implemented** (लागू करना): To put something into effect or practice.
 
 
• **Example: **The government implemented new policies to improve education standards.
 
 
 
• **Liberated** (मुक्त करना): To free someone or something from restrictions or captivity.
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers liberated the town from enemy control.
